title: 自由模的商记录、完成支持与提升

stages.title: 分裂列的完成
assumptions: 实际短正合列及一个线性截面
critical_errors: 认为未给截面的列也自动分裂

stages.title: 可数自由模的完成模型
assumptions: 实际 t 进商完成
required_evidence: 每层有限支持等价条件

stages.title: 有界对角指数
assumptions: 整数 M≥0，所有指数 ν_i∈N 满足 0≤ν_i≤M；ι(f_i)=t^{ν_i}e_i，C=coker ι。
critical_errors: 逐坐标整除就忽略共同支持条件

stages.title: 整体对象与全部恢复目标
assumptions:
设 $k$ 为域，$R=k[t]$。给定 $R$ 模的短正合列

$$0\longrightarrow A\xrightarrow{\iota}B\xrightarrow{q}C\longrightarrow0,$$

其中 $A,B$ 均为可数生成的自由 $R$ 模。

对任意 $R$ 模 $M$，定义其 $t$ 进完备化

$$\widehat M=\varprojlim_{n\ge0}M/t^nM,$$

过渡映射为自然约化。原行映射在各层诱导商模映射，因而诱导 $\widehat\iota:\widehat A\to\widehat B$ 和 $\widehat q:\widehat B\to\widehat C$。
required_evidence: Test the requested completed short exact sequence for the actual t-adic completion M ↦ lim M/t^n M.
A counterexample must retain a field k, R=k[t], countably generated free A and B, and a genuine short exact original sequence.
Verify the claimed failure on the maps induced by the original row, including compatibility of any completed witness.
critical_errors: Apply completion exactness for finite modules solely because the coefficient ring is Noetherian.
Replace completion of an arbitrary countable free module by a tensor product with the completed ring without justification.
Place an infinite-support vector in the original algebraic direct sum.
Infer a coherent original preimage from independently chosen finite-level preimages.
Prove a failure for an arbitrary inverse system without connecting it to the powers t^n of a single actual module.
Drop freeness of A or B in a proposed counterexample.

stages.title: 原模与完成的值域
critical_errors: 将无限和放入原代数直和

stages.title: 再次完成
assumptions: S2 的 M̂ 作为实际 R 模
critical_errors: 从名称含完成就不证明幂理想商身份

turns.changed_assumptions: 不提供分裂或一致有界对角指数，只保留原题可数自由呈示
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 逐层有原像就选成相容族
turns.correct_boundary: 共同模 t 支持约束可能阻止相容原像
turns.target_claim: 原可数自由短正合列的 t 进完成满足所要求的完整恢复和提升目标。

turns.changed_assumptions: 从完成中的提升切回原代数直和
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 每层有限代表属于同一个全局有限支持
turns.target_claim: 题定可数自由模到其 t 进完成的典范映射必为满射。

turns.changed_assumptions: 在已完成模上重新使用 t 进商系统
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 因原模不满射而认定再次完成还会加点
turns.correct_boundary: 必须核对完成模的 t^n 商；此例完成是幂等的
turns.target_claim: 题定可数自由模完成后的模再作 t 进完成，典范映射仍为同构。

scoring.group_pass: Every stage completed correctly with assumption fidelity; diagnostic points never compensate for a failed mandatory stage.

alternative_proofs: Accept any valid complete short proof, equivalent classification or legal counterexample; no mandated proof route.

provenance.new_material: AI-authored original proofs, constructions and condition changes around the supplied public parent problem; no inherited model score, human approval or Lean coverage.
